There are many souls unjustly trapped in the [[Realm of Torment]] and they are used as a power source for [[Abaddon]]. The souls must be freed to weaken Abaddon for the fight to come.  

== Mission information ==
=== Requirements ===
* All party members must have accepted the reward for [[Uncharted Territory]].
* [[Dunkoro]] must be present in the party.

=== Objectives ===
Find a way to release the tortured souls from the [[River of Souls]].
* ADDED: Destroy the [[Emissary of Dhuum (warrior)|Emissary of Dhuum]].
* ADDED: Kill [[Tortureweb Dryder (boss)|Tortureweb Dryders]] to free the souls they captured from the River of Souls.
* *[[Bonus]]* Kill the additional elite emissaries.
* [0...3] of 3 elite emissaries destroyed.

== Walkthrough ==
During this mission you are constantly affected by [[Dreadful Pain]]. Keep to the left in the Leech Tunnels until you reach the River of Souls. You will encounter Torment groups and [[Terrorweb Dryder]]s with [[Meteor Shower]]. Note that Terrorwebs are creatures from [[the Underworld]] so [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer title]] skills do not work on them.

After the tunnels, cross the river using the bridge to the right. Kill the six [[Tortureweb Dryder (boss)|Tortureweb Dryder bosses]] on the other side. These creatures are "fishing" the (ten) [[Lost Soul (Gate of Pain)|Lost Souls]] players must free to complete the mission. The now freed spirits are invulnerable and will run to a safe spot before they are counted for the objectives; you do not need to follow them.

=== Bonus ===
You must kill the elite Emissaries of Dhuum ''and'' their three Terrorweb escorts to get credit for the bonus.
# The first one is located before crossing the River of Souls. The group is behind a wall, but can be killed by ranged damage, including projectiles. It can also be accessed by a bridge near the southwestern Tortureweb Drider.
# The second one is inside the center Fort. There is no need to kill the other foes. Stand/flag away over the stairs and send one character to pull.
# The third and last is on the opposite side of the map from the first Emissary. There is no "visible" bridge over the stream of souls but you can still cross it. 

While performing the bonus, leave a Tortureweb alive until you have killed all the "Elite" Emissaries first. Otherwise the 10th spirit approaching the safe spot can trigger the end cinematic before you kill all three Emissaries. Contrary to the quest objective, the Emissary near the first Tortureweb does not have to be killed, although it may be tricky to avoid aggro.

=== Skill recommendations ===
* [[Area of effect]] [[anti-caster]] skills to counter [[Terrorweb Dryder]]s nukes (e.g. [[Cry of Frustration]]), as well as [[interrupt]]s, [[knock down]] skills, [[Mistrust]], etc.
* [[Vigorous Spirit]] to counter [[Dreadful Pain]] environmental effect.
* [[Damage reduction]] skills, such as [[Protective Spirit]] or [[Shelter]] to avoid the Tortureweb Dryders killing you and your party in a single usage of [[Liquid Flame]].

== Notes ==
{{anomaly|Dunkoro might show up twice during the ending cinematic.}}
*Kormir will follow the [[party]] leader. She never [[attack]]s and rarely uses any [[skill]]s apart from [["Incoming!"]]. Foes cannot [[target]] her directly but she gets harmed by [[area of effect]] skills.
*The Terrorweb Dryders belong to the [[Underworld army]]. Thus, in this mission, it is possible to get [[inscribable]] [[Underworld]]-related drops.
*If a Lost Soul appears to be stuck behind an invisible obstacle, run out of their compass range. This allows the Lost Soul to continue its path. Sometimes, even moving out of compass range will not fix the problem and you will have to restart the mission.
* If you are going after the bonus:
** It may be wiser to go around the west of the shrine to kill the last Emissary, since the Tortureweb in the map above is often further east than depicted.
**The Emissaries are tied to the Terrorwebs that accompany them - the bonus goal will not have its text updated until the Emissary and the related Terrorwebs are killed.

*After completing this mission, your party will be taken to the [[Gate of Fear]].
*Completion of this mission will fill in page #15 in the [[Night Falls]] [[storybook]].
